# Nyrava

> Nyrava Intelligence is a legal intelligence operating system for attorneys and litigation teams. It turns case documents into structured, citation-grounded legal analysis using a locked, defensible report engine.

Nyrava helps lawyers and legal professionals build case analysis, manage evidence, and produce litigation-ready reports. The platform is built around a frozen 17-section report engine, a pipeline-gated evidence system, and a confidentiality-first architecture. It supports bring-your-own AI keys (OpenAI, Google, Groq, and others) and workspace-based team collaboration.

- [/product/evidence-intelligence](/product/evidence-intelligence): Grounded, cited fact extraction from the case corpus.
- [/product/timeline-intelligence](/product/timeline-intelligence): Automatic chronology reconstruction with cited events.
- [/product/witness-intelligence](/product/witness-intelligence): Cluster statements, surface contradictions.
- [/product/constitutional-intelligence](/product/constitutional-intelligence): CPEUM and derechos humanos issue spotting.
- [/product/motion-intelligence](/product/motion-intelligence): First-draft motions grounded in the record.
- [/product/report-intelligence](/product/report-intelligence): Canonical 17-section case analysis, export-ready.
